criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Opening two lines name a live XPRIZE deployment (1,000 sq km NANA zone, UAF/ACUASI) and frame the structural tension (inputs being cut/stalled). Specific and stakes-forward.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: Every story carries an explicit AK anchor and a named consequence: $386M OOI / $5.3B fishery / Dec 2026 harvest cycle; 34-5 House vote / June 21 deadline / 20.7 cents per kWh / 100-plus MW; GCI four named hubs / edge inference.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named specifics in nearly every sentence: dates, dollar amounts, vote counts, deadlines, locations, named entities (Murkowski, NSF, Glenfarne, GCI, UAF/ACUASI).

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: OOI has Senate primary press release + signed letter; GCI and XPRIZE primary. LNG relies on two Alaska Public Media articles from one outlet with no primary legislative source (medium confidence in findings).

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Strong match to post_001.md: analytical, structural, position-taking, business-literate without influencer cadence. Minor metaphor drift on 'the substrate isn't retreating uniformly'.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 407 words / 2,603 chars in band. Paragraphs 2-4 sentences, scannable. LNG paragraph densest but fine.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closes with a genuine three-way prioritization tied to the input-layer frame, no softener, no CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Concrete revisit triggers: June 29 DAF proposals, June 21 LNG deadline, Dec 2026 OOI/harvest exposure, GCI middle-mile positioning.
